# viettelidc_ovpc_backup_schedulers (Data Source)

List the backup schedules of a VPC.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "viettelidc_ovpc_backup_schedulers" "all" {
  vpc_id = data.viettelidc_ovpc_vpc.main.id
}

output "schedule_ids" {
  value = { for s in data.viettelidc_ovpc_backup_schedulers.all.schedulers : s.name => s.id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `vpc_id` (String) VPC filter; falls back to the provider default vpc_id.

### Read-Only

- `schedulers` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedulers))

### Nested Schema for `schedulers`

- `vm_number` (Number) How many VMs the schedule covers.
